title: План украсть платье  (The Plan to Steal the Dress)

segments.t: At the apartment, Kostya tells Denis that since he truly loves Katya, they must ruin the wedding by stealing her wedding gown. Meanwhile, outside the club, Sveta pulls up in her car and offers Katya and Nastya a ride home.
Привет, девичник прошёл у вас хорошо?
Now let's go back through their conversation line by line and unpack the Russian phrasing.
'After all, you love her.' In Russian, the idea of 'and' flows naturally into 'love' without extra filler words.
'I do, and what does that mean?' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'like' and finishing on 'so'. Kostya answers right away.
'We must ruin this wedding.' Notice how Russian expresses 'we' and 'wedding' with crisp inflection rather than helper words.
'I agree, but how?' The grammar packs 'I' and 'how' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'We can steal her wedding dress.' Kostya brings out the contrast between 'can' and 'to steal' in a few short words. Denis answers right away.
'They stole my wedding dress!' An emphatic spoken line centered on the verb meaning 'stole'.
'Or we can steal Katya herself.' The grammar packs 'or' and 'oneself' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'We will just take her without the wedding dress.' The meaning hinges on 'simply' working together with 'dress' in spoken Russian. Denis answers right away.
'Did you understand me, my friend?' The '-l' ending on the verb meaning 'understood' places the action in the masculine past tense.
Привет, девичник прошёл у вас хорошо?
'Hi, did your bachelorette party go well?' Sveta chooses the respectful plural 'you' alongside 'well' to keep a polite distance.
'Oh yes, everything went fine.' Notice how Russian expresses 'about' and 'normally' with crisp inflection rather than helper words. Sveta answers right away.

'Then get in, I will give you a ride.' Sveta chooses the respectful plural 'you' alongside 'I will give a ride' to keep a polite distance. Alright, let's hear the entire conversation one more time from start to finish.
Привет, девичник прошёл у вас хорошо?
When Sveta steps out of her car for a moment, Katya makes a heartfelt confession to Nastya right in front of the running dashcam. See you next time!
